question: Where and when will the 59th National Cross Country Championships - 2025 be held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12th January 2025, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **59th National Cross Country Championships** is scheduled to be held on **12th January 2025**.
 
• The event will take place in **Meerut, Uttar Pradesh**, a city known for its rich history and sports culture.
 
• **Cross Country Championships** are athletic events conducted over natural terrains such as grass, dirt trails, or hills, emphasizing endurance and strategy.
 
• The event is organized under the guidance of the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)**, which is the apex body for athletics in India.
 
• Meerut has a prominent reputation in sports equipment manufacturing and is a major contributor to the sports industry in India, making it a fitting choice for hosting such events.
 
• This championship attracts participants from across the nation, providing a platform for talented athletes to showcase their skills and gain recognition.
 
• Hosting the championship in Uttar Pradesh aligns with the state’s efforts to promote sports and athletics, further boosting regional development in this sector.

__
 
• **10th January 2025, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Lucknow**, the capital city of Uttar Pradesh, is renowned for its **historical monuments** and **cultural heritage**.
 
• It has been a host to various national-level events and is equipped with modern **sports infrastructure**.
 
 
 
• **15th January 2025, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Kanpur** is an industrial hub and one of the largest cities in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The city has a growing focus on **sports** and **athletics**, with several recent initiatives to upgrade its sports facilities.
 
 
 
• **12th January 2025, Jaipur, Rajasthan**__
 
 
• **Jaipur**, the capital of Rajasthan, is known as the **Pink City** due to its distinct architectural style.
 
• Although primarily famous for its **tourism**, Jaipur has hosted various sports events in the past.
